items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Jerry' in an anecdote about Bud Freeman and Giants of Jazz; the interviewee (Zutty Singleton) does not respond with any personal connection or confirmation of knowing Jerry.

ctx.x: Sure. Like Bud Freeman told us the last time we talked with him how some beautiful girl was hanging around Giants of Jazz in the end when the night ended, you know. And said, Jerry's the (aint he?) I was the one she wanted. (LAUGHTER).
Yes, and he was kind of surprised.
